examples.english: “--it is the word which Pistis Sophia hath spoken: 'And thou hast taken all my powers in which was no light, and hast bestowed on them within purified light, and unto all my limbs, in which no light stirred, thou hast given life-light out of thy Height.' And the word which thy power hath spoken: Thy way is become indestructibleness, and thy face [also],”
